# Career Gap & Resume Advisor

Scrape a job posting URL or paste text, upload your resume or paste it, and get a full gap analysis — learning pathways, resume rewrites, career stepping stones, networking opportunities, and a phased growth roadmap.

## Overview

The Career Gap Analyzer helps job seekers understand exactly where they stand relative to their dream job — and more importantly, how to close the gap. Paste any job posting alongside your resume and get an AI-powered analysis that breaks down your match across every dimension, identifies critical gaps, and builds a personalized learning pathway with real courses, certifications, and a phased roadmap.

Unlike a simple resume match score, this tool is designed to be actionable. Every gap comes with specific resources, time estimates, and priorities so you know exactly what to work on first.

## How It Works

1. Add a job posting — Paste a URL to scrape the posting from LinkedIn, Indeed, or any job site. Or paste the text directly. Or use the sample data to explore immediately.
2. Add your resume — Upload a PDF or DOCX file, or paste your resume text directly.
3. Set your timeline — Choose how aggressively you want to close gaps: 3 months, 6 months, 1 year, or flexible.
4. Review seven result tabs — Match Overview, Gap Details, Resume Updates, Learning Pathway, Career Path, Networking, and Roadmap.
